title: 第一卷 第22章 原为人族执剑！！
content_zh:
就连陈渊都是满脸疑惑，他跟着陆承锋一年了，对方什么时候有剑了？

    “快点……跟上。”

    前方的陆承锋沙哑开口，似乎费了极大的劲，才勉强说出这句话。

    话音落下，他的速度看起来明明不快，身影却已然出现在十几米开外。

    陆承锋的身形一拉开，四周顿时阴冷下来，仿佛有无数模糊的身影要跟上来，又像是有许多张牙舞爪的黑影，正朝着陈渊几人扑来。

    陈渊几人打了个激灵，连忙快步跟上。

    约莫又行走了几个时辰，陈渊等人早已眼皮打架，又累又困，几乎要撑不住了。

    陆承锋见状，寻到一处山体，拔出背后背着的长剑，在陈渊几人震惊的目光中，快速挖好了一个山洞。

    陈昭宁的嘴巴张成了O形，脸上满是佩服，又带着几分无奈。

    不过，能有个山洞歇一晚，陈渊和李伟还是格外兴奋。

    他们把大黑马留在洞外，几人弯腰钻了进去。

    没多久，他们又在山洞里升起了一团火光。

    起初陈渊还担心生火会引来旁人注意，可陆承锋在洞口一坐，洞内的气息竟一丝都没能往外面溢出。

    洞内瞬间变得温暖起来，火光映照得几人脸蛋红扑扑的，驱散了大半的疲惫和阴冷。

    陈渊、李伟、陈昭宁三人都陷入了沉默，相互靠着，昏昏欲睡，

    可肚子里此起彼伏的咕噜声，却让他们难以入眠。

    就连糯米也忍不住摸了摸肚子，舔了舔嘴唇，一脸馋相。

    从中午出发，下午经历了一场恶战，再到这大半夜，几人连一口东西都没吃过。

    好不容易能松口气歇息，饥饿感便如猛兽般扑来，让几人饿得前胸贴后背。

    陈渊亦是如此，即便他已是灵窍境大圆满，此刻也觉得饿得格外厉害。

    他心里清楚，这恐怕是身体机能的缘故。

    境界越高，消耗越大，自然需要摄入更多的能量。

    这时，坐在山洞口的陆承锋缓缓起身，走了出去。

    “糯米，你爹去哪儿？”

    李伟看了一眼，又看向糯米，好奇地问道。

    “嘻嘻，太好了！我爹肯定是去打猎啦！”

    糯米兴奋地拍手说道。

    李伟闻言，顿时大喜过望，忍不住咽了咽口水，眼里满是期待。

    果然，没过多久，陆承锋便单手提着一头脑袋被打爆的野猪走了回来。

    陈渊几人看得眼睛发直，艰难地咽了咽口水。

    这野猪显然是被陆承锋一拳打爆了脑袋，肚子也被撕开，里面的内脏早已不见踪影。

    “吃。”

    陆承锋只吐出一个字，声音依旧带着几分阴沉。

    陈渊和李伟立刻动手，借着陈昭宁的刀，割下几块野猪肉架在火上烤。

    等烤到油光锃亮、外皮微焦时，一股浓郁的肉香，瞬间充斥了整个山洞，让几人口舌生津，馋意更甚。

    于是，陈渊几人像是饿死鬼投胎一般，对着烤野猪肉大快朵颐，狼吞虎咽地吃了起来。

    尤其是陈渊，吃得格外快。

    他感觉此刻自己的牙齿无比锋利，即便野猪肉韧性十足，也能被他快速咬碎，化作一股暖流涌入体内，转化为源源不断的能量。

    渐渐地，伴随着他周身气旋运转，也就是那三百六十一个灵窍，在他周身缓缓浮现，
content_en:
Even Chen Yuan was full of doubts. He had been following Lu Chengfeng for a year. When did the other party have a sword?

    "Hurry up... follow up."

    Lu Chengfeng in front spoke hoarsely, seeming to have spent a lot of effort to manage to say these words.

    As soon as he finished speaking, his speed seemed obviously unhappy, but his figure had already appeared more than ten meters away.

    As soon as Lu Chengfeng pulled away, the surrounding area suddenly became cold, as if there were countless vague figures trying to follow, and it seemed like there were many black shadows with teeth and claws, rushing towards Chen Yuan and the others.

    Chen Yuan and others trembled and hurriedly followed.

    After walking for about a few more hours, Chen Yuan and others' eyelids were already fighting, they were tired and sleepy, and could hardly hold on.

    Seeing this, Lu Chengfeng found a mountain, pulled out the long sword on his back, and quickly dug a cave under the shocked eyes of Chen Yuan and others.

    Chen Zhaoning's mouth opened into an O shape, his face full of admiration and a bit helpless.

    However, Chen Yuan and Li Wei were extremely excited to have a cave to rest for a night.

    They left the big black horse outside the cave, and several people bent down and got in.

    Not long after, they lit up another fire in the cave.

    At first, Chen Yuan was worried that lighting a fire would attract the attention of others, but as soon as Lu Chengfeng sat at the entrance of the cave, not a trace of the breath inside the cave could escape outside.

    The cave instantly became warm, and the firelight made several people's faces turn red, dispelling most of their fatigue and coldness.

    Chen Yuan, Li Wei, and Chen Zhaoning all fell into silence, leaning on each other and falling asleep.

    But the gurgling sounds in their stomachs made it difficult for them to sleep.

    Even Nuomi couldn't help but touch his belly and lick his lips with a greedy look on his face.

    Starting at noon, they experienced a fierce battle in the afternoon, and in the middle of the night, several people had not even eaten a bite.

    After finally breathing a sigh of relief, the feeling of hunger pounced on them like a beast, making several people feel so hungry that their chests pressed against their backs.

    The same is true for Chen Yuan. Even though he has reached the Great Perfection of the Spiritual Aperture Realm, he feels extremely hungry at this moment.

    He knew in his heart that this was probably due to his body's function.

    The higher the realm, the greater the consumption, and naturally more energy needs to be taken in.

    At this time, Lu Chengfeng, who was sitting at the entrance of the cave, slowly stood up and walked out.

    "Nuomi, where is your father going?"

    Li Wei took a look, then looked at Nuomi, and asked curiously.

    "Hehe, great! My dad must have gone hunting!"

    Nuomi said excitedly, clapping her hands.

    When Li Wei heard this, he was immediately overjoyed and couldn't help but swallow his saliva, his eyes full of anticipation.

    Sure enough, not long after, Lu Chengfeng came back carrying a wild boar with its head blown off in one hand.

    Chen Yuan and others' eyes were straightened and they swallowed hard.

    This wild boar had obviously been punched in the head by Lu Chengfeng, and its stomach had been torn open, with its internal organs already missing.

    "Eat."

    Lu Chengfeng only uttered one word, his voice still a bit gloomy.

    Chen Yuan and Li Wei immediately started to use Chen Zhaoning's knife to cut off several pieces of wild boar meat and roast them on the fire.

    When it was roasted until it was shiny and the skin was slightly charred, a rich aroma of meat instantly filled the entire cave, making several people salivate and become even more greedy.

    As a result, Chen Yuan and others feasted on the roasted wild boar meat as if they were reincarnated by starving ghosts, and devoured it hungrily.

    Especially Chen Yuan ate very quickly.

    He felt that his teeth were extremely sharp at this moment. Even if the wild boar meat was very tough, he could quickly bite it into pieces and turn it into a warm current flowing into his body, transforming it into a steady stream of energy.

    Gradually, as the cyclone circulated around him, the three hundred and sixty-one spiritual orifices slowly emerged around him,
